_comment: Text that must never reach a visitor-facing summary, and that bin/scan_placeholders.py reports at cutover. One source: read by inc/section-index.php and bin/scan_placeholders.py. Each pattern is a regular expression valid in both PCRE (PHP) and Python, matched case-insensitively; 'example' must match (checked by ~/src/mbc-tests/section_index_check.py patterns).

patterns.pattern: Add the day and time|Add the room or address|Add who is welcome|Add a name and an email
patterns.label: activity prompt
patterns.example: Add the day and time, for example Sundays

patterns.pattern: Describe what happens|Add a short introduction|Add a heading|Add the main text of the page
patterns.label: info prompt

patterns.pattern: Add a short summary of this partner|Add how people|Add a sentence or two about how this partnership
patterns.label: partner prompt
patterns.example: Add a short summary of this partner

patterns.pattern: Write a short introduction|Write the main text here|Delete this box if the page
patterns.label: post/info prompt
patterns.example: Delete this box if the page does not need it

patterns.pattern: will appear here|will be listed here|coming soon
patterns.label: placeholder text
